title: Advancing Health Equity through Multi-Level Fairness in Health Informatics
abstract: arXiv:2608.16902v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The increasing integration of machine learning in healthcare has highlighted critical challenges related to fairness, transparency, and health equity. Specifically, the use of multi-level fairness techniques, which combine multiple bias mitigation steps or techniques, show promise for reducing biases across different patient demographics, yet this approach remains underexplored in terms of its health equity outcomes. In this paper, we assess the current landscape of multi-level fairness in health informatics by focusing on its impact on equitable healthcare outcomes and evaluating how transparency and reporting standards contribute to these advancements. Through an examination of the existing literature, we identify key gaps in both the implementation of multi-level fairness techniques and the consistent reporting of health equity impacts. translated_title: 通过健康信息学中的多层次公平推进健康公平
translated_abstract: 机器学习在医疗保健中的日益整合凸显了与公平性、透明度和健康公平相关的关键挑战。具体而言，使用多层次公平技术（结合多种偏见缓解步骤或技术）在减少不同患者群体间的偏见方面显示出潜力，但这种方法在健康公平结果方面的探索仍然不足。在本文中，我们通过关注多层次公平对公平医疗结果的影响，并评估透明度和报告标准如何促进这些进展，来评估健康信息学中多层次公平的当前状况。通过对现有文献的审查，我们识别出多层次公平技术实施和健康公平影响一致性报告方面的关键差距。此外，我们分析了报告标准（如MINIMAR和TRIPOD）在改进这些方面中的作用。
tldr: 本文评估了健康信息学中多层次公平技术的现状，指出了其在实施和健康公平影响报告方面的关键差距，并分析了报告标准在促进公平医疗结果中的作用。
en_tdlr: This paper assesses the current state of multi-level fairness in health informatics, identifies key gaps in implementation and health equity impact reporting, and analyzes the role of reporting standards in advancing equitable healthcare outcomes.
